units.source_text: 八月中旬，我接到了一位朋友的来信。

en.t: In mid August, I received a letter from a friend.

units.source_text: 信里写的是，有一个去地方中学当教员的机会，问我是否想去。

en.t: The letter said there was an opportunity to become a teacher at a provincial middle school, and asked whether I wanted to go.

units.source_text: 这位朋友由于经济上的原因，自己四处在寻求这样的职业。

en.t: Because of his financial circumstances, this friend had been looking everywhere for that kind of position himself.

units.source_text: 这个工作他本来是为自己找的，

en.t: He had originally found this job for himself,

units.source_text: 但后来又找到了更好的地方，所以特意来信告诉我，想把这个富余的机会让给我。

en.t: but later he found a better place, so he wrote especially to tell me and offer me the extra opportunity.

units.source_text: 我马上回信谢绝了。

en.t: I immediately wrote back and declined.

units.source_text: 我告诉他，有个朋友正费尽周折地想要找个教员的工作，

en.t: I told him that I had a friend who was going to great trouble trying to find a teaching job,

units.source_text: 还是转让给他吧。

en.t: and that he should pass it on to him instead.

units.source_text: 我回信之后便跟父母说了这件事，

en.t: After I sent my reply, I told my parents about it,

units.source_text: 他们俩好像对我的拒绝都没有什么意见。

en.t: and neither of them seemed to object to my refusal.

units.source_text: “不去那种地方，你也会有更合适的工作的，对吧？”

en.t: You can find a more suitable job without going to a place like that, can't you?

units.source_text: 从这句话里，我听出他们对我寄予的希望过高了。

en.t: From those words, I could hear that their hopes for me were too high.

units.source_text: 迂腐的父母好像期望着刚刚毕业的我，会得到相当理想的地位和收入。

en.t: My old fashioned parents seemed to expect that I, newly graduated, would obtain a fairly ideal position and income.

units.source_text: “合适的工作？

en.t: A suitable job?

units.source_text: 近来，那么好的工作是很难找到的。

en.t: These days, it is very hard to find a job that good.

units.source_text: 况且哥哥和我的专业不同，时代也不同了，

en.t: Besides, my elder brother and I studied different fields, and the times have changed too,

units.source_text: 老拿我和哥哥相比，可有点难办。”

en.t: so it is a little difficult if you keep comparing me with him.

units.source_text: “既然你已经毕业了，至少应该能够养活自己，不能老靠着家里。

en.t: Since you have already graduated, you ought at least to be able to support yourself, instead of always depending on the family.

units.source_text: 要是别人问起来，你家老二大学毕业后做什么事啊？

en.t: If someone asks what your second son is doing after graduating from university,

units.source_text: 我回答不出来的话，这老脸往哪儿放啊？”

en.t: and I cannot answer, how am I supposed to show my face?
